newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia shares ease as Westerners wait, traders say.
newsitem.headline: Russia shares ease as Westerners wait, traders say.

text.p: Western investors expecting even lower prices failed to snap up easing Russian shares on Wednesday though the weak market is nearing support levels, traders said.
The Russian Trading System index of 23 shares fell by 2.96 percent to 320.23 on $32.11 million on total market volume.

Ordinary shares of UES EESR.RTS power utility fell to $0.2130 from $0.2250 at Tuesday's close. Krasnoyarskenergo KRNG.RTS power utility dropped to $0.420 from $0.450, hit by sales by a local operator, one trader said.

"Foreign investors consider the market overheated and count on it to ease," said United City Bank securities department head Dmitry Yevenko. "Sales were only at bid prices today. No one bought at mid-market and it was almost impossble to trade."
But traders said they had seen some cautious buying begin during the day.
"I can see very cheap paper on the market," said Creditanstalt chief trader Andrei Galperin, forecasting the market would not fall more than another five percent.
Yevenko agreed the correction would be short.
"There is no big potential for a fall, there will always be Russian support," Yevenko said.
